query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Generate and post-process a long text-to-speech audio asset, upload it to cloud storage, research YouTube content opportunities and comments, then update YouTube channel branding metadata.
query_ground_truth.intent: Update the metadata for the YouTube channel's branding.

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if channel ID is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the channel ID using YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_ID_BY_HANDLE (map a public handle to the correct channel before any write).
[Optional (if handle lookup fails or is ambiguous)] [Fallback]: Confirm the intended channel using YOUTUBE_SEARCH_YOU_TUBE (avoid updating the wrong channel).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Baseline current metadata using YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_STATISTICS (read snippet/brandingSettings/localizations so unchanged fields can be preserved).
[Optional (if homepage presentation could be impacted)] [Prerequisite]: Review current layout context using YOUTUBE_LIST_CHANNEL_SECTIONS (spot section-related surprises before branding edits).

[Required] [Step]: Apply description/title/language/branding edits using YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL (send a complete brandingSettings.channel payload for only the fields you control, carrying forward the rest from the baseline).
[Optional (if updating localized metadata)] [Step]: Apply localization edits using YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL (run as a separate call from brandingSettings to prevent part conflicts).
[Required] [Next Step]: Verify persistence by re-reading via YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_STATISTICS and comparing returned snippet/brandingSettings to the intended outcome.
known_pitfalls: [YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL] HTTP 400 invalidPart can occur when mixing brandingSettings and localizations; split into separate calls.
[YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL] brandingSettings.channel is authoritative; omitting fields you meant to keep can clear or unintentionally change existing branding metadata.
[YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL] The write response may not reflect the new value immediately; verify by re-reading with YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_STATISTICS.
[YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_STATISTICS] Response shape can vary (e.g., items[] vs other containers); extraction logic should not assume a single path.
[YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_ID_BY_HANDLE] Handle lookup may fail if the handle is wrong/outdated; confirm channel identity before any write.

YOUTUBE_UPDATE_CHANNEL.description: Updates a channel's metadata including branding settings and localizations. Only brandingSettings, invideoPromotion, and localizations properties can be updated. Requires the channel to be owned by the authenticated user.

id.description: The channel ID being updated. This is the unique YouTube channel identifier that typically starts with 'UC'.

part.description: Comma-separated list of channel resource properties to update. Must include at least one of: brandingSettings, invideoPromotion, or localizations. The 'part' parameter identifies the properties that the write operation will set.

localizations.description: Translated metadata for the channel, keyed by BCP-47 language code (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French). Each value contains localized title and description.

description.title: Description
examples: Bienvenido a mi canal donde comparto contenido increíble!

title.description: The channel's title. Maximum length is 30 characters.

country.description: The country with which the channel is associated (two-letter country code).

keywords.description: Keywords associated with the channel. Space-separated list with a maximum total length of 500 characters.

examples: Welcome to my channel where I share amazing content!
description.description: The channel's description. Maximum length is 1000 characters.

defaultLanguage.description: The language of the channel's metadata (BCP-47 language code).

unsubscribedTrailer.description: The video ID of the channel trailer shown to unsubscribed viewers.

trackingAnalyticsAccountId.description: The ID for a Google Analytics account to track channel traffic.

channel.description: Branding settings for a YouTube channel.

invideoPromotion.description: The invideoPromotion object encapsulates information about a promotional campaign associated with the channel. It includes details about promoted items and their timing.

onBehalfOfContentOwner.description: For authorized requests only. Allows content partners to act on behalf of the specified channel owner. The content owner must already be linked to the channel.

YOUTUBE_GET_CHANNEL_ID_BY_HANDLE.description: Retrieves the YouTube Channel ID for a specific YouTube channel handle.

channel_handle.description: The YouTube channel handle (e.g., '@Google' or 'Google'). Accepts handles with or without the '@' prefix. Also accepts full YouTube channel URLs (e.g., 'https://www.youtube.com/@Google'), from which the handle will be automatically extracted.

YOUTUBE_SEARCH_YOU_TUBE.description: Searches YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists using a query term, returning the raw API response.

q.description: Search query term. Supports: - Basic text: 'machine learning' - Exact phrases: '"exact phrase"' - Exclusions: 'python -snake' - Multiple terms: 'AI OR ML' - Channel search: '@channelhandle' or channel name

part.description: The part parameter specifies properties to include in the response. For the search.list endpoint, only 'snippet' is a valid value. The 'id' object is always returned automatically with every search result (no quota cost). Note: 'statistics', 'contentDetails', etc. are only available on the videos.list endpoint, not search.list.

type.description: Restricts search to 'video', 'channel', or 'playlist'; comma-separate for multiple types (e.g., 'video,channel').

order.description: Sort order for YouTube search results.

pageToken.description: Pagination token from a previous response's 'nextPageToken' or 'prevPageToken', used to retrieve a specific page of results.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of items to return per page.

regionCode.description: Return search results for videos viewable in the specified country. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

publishedAfter.description: Filter results to only include resources created at or after the specified time. RFC 3339 formatted date-time.

publishedBefore.description: Filter results to only include resources created before or at the specified time. RFC 3339 formatted date-time.

relevanceLanguage.description: Return results most relevant to the specified language. ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (use 'zh-Hans' for simplified Chinese, 'zh-Hant' for traditional Chinese).
